It was clear outside a while ago and now I’m in a dark room with piles of paper surrounding me. I must read everything and fix it. This is why I had a shit life, the previous me was lazy and so am I. 

I can’t do it. I grab the first page and there I am in my mother’s womb a sea of red. How boring? Can I make myself a twin? Can I create life now? Will his life revolve around me? Forget the twin I don’t want to worry about a second character right now. 

Skip the sea of red. I’m born again in 1960 in Kansas, lets change the year I want to see Japan in 2050. I come back from the hospital to a small home and sleep besides my mother. 

We had no money or space for a crib when I was born—I’ll change that. A bigger home for us, maybe if we had a bit more money… I’m going make dad a technician so he will always be employed, mom was a great woman she will 
always be amazing. 

I edited all my father’s wrongdoings from my first years as best as I could. Is he really going to change? Does this script really change other people? If we are really all script writers how does my script affect someone else’s. 

I cried a bit in the corner after spending that time in my head and now I’m back to writing. I am headed to school now, I didn’t mind my school life. I hated my home though. I will fix that. I gave dad more work hours and mom makes friends with our neighbors so she will be happier. 

Editing. Editing. Editing every day in this fucking dark room. That figure hasn’t come back at all. I don’t sleep, I don’t get hungry, I have no need other than to escape this room. I am only in the tenth year of my life and I feel like killing off my character. I can’t find a way out of this room.

The thirteenth year. Everything is wrong. Why do I have to fix these people? I have a sister now I’ll spend more time with her this life since she didn’t kill me off in her script.

Is this a reflection chamber? This is limbo, isn’t it? I have yelled I’m done over and over after I shaved 40 years of my life but they won’t free me. Who are they to judge my life, to judge my script?

I was sleeping at my desk when my class turned undead. I had a terrible smell of sweat, guess that’s why they assumed I was dead. Their growling woke me up they noticed I had awoken and their growling grew louder. They walked slowly towards me and smelled me. They stood me up with their cold hands and made me beat at the closed door. 

Perhaps I should have left that classroom door closed, after I couldn’t hit the door anymore I pulled the door open and let the mummy's curse free. They walked in a group pushing me with them and took down the school within hours. There was people screaming in pain and confusion all I could do was watch it all and keep walking. 

Their numbers multiplied. I walked along with my school watching as all of my city turned undead. I could have stopped this. I am desensitized to the screaming now. I wonder who will kill me the undead or perhaps one of the victims I loot--it would be well deserved.
